title: HDL Dev waveform spec
description: Validates waveform specs under docs/waveforms/specs. The name controls WAVEFORM=<name> and the generated SVG filename.

name.description: Spec identifier. This should match the filename stem and the Make WAVEFORM value.

title.description: Human-readable title for generated waveform documentation.

tb.description: GEnCor-compatible testbench name. Prefer this field over the fixture-only testbench alias.

testbench.description: HDL Dev fixture alias for the testbench name. Prefer tb in project specs.

tb_run_args.description: Extra Make or GHDL generic arguments, for example -gName=value.

time_start.description: Optional waveform crop start such as 0ns.

time_end.description: Optional waveform crop end such as 120ns.

signals.description: Ordered signal rows to render. Signal paths are not semantically checked by this schema.

label.description: Display label for the generated waveform row.
